title: Zero total staked state enables reward loss griefing
description: When totalStaked reaches zero (all users have unstaked), any rewards that continue to accrue during this period may be permanently lost or misdistributed when the next user stakes. The reward calculation logic does not properly handle the edge case of zero total stake, leading to reward tokens becoming unclaimable or being disproportionately allocated to the first user who stakes after the zero-stake period.
impact: Permanent loss of reward tokens during periods when no users are staked. An attacker could grief the protocol by timing unstakes to create zero-stake windows, causing reward leakage.
attackPath: Wait for or create conditions where totalStaked approaches zero
Unstake remaining tokens to trigger zero totalStaked state
Allow rewards to accrue during zero-stake period
Rewards are lost or misdistributed when staking resumes
recommendation: Implement proper handling for the zero totalStaked edge case. Consider pausing reward accrual when totalStaked is zero, or accumulating rewards in a buffer to be distributed when staking resumes.
